description: This file is a Perl script used for flashing firmware onto a Linksys ADSL2MUE device. It includes socket communication, device discovery, and FTP-based firmware upload functionalities.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with additional methods for specific commands used during the firmware flashing process, such as environment variable retrieval and device reboot.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script and exits.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get an environment variable via FTP.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Issues a reboot command to the device via FTP.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.
